# Rust error codes

*Generated by `rust/scripts/reference.py` from Toskar Core's error catalog and the SDK's own codes.*

The codes Toskar Core and the SDK answer errors with, as `Error::code`, with each one's English text. Core's are constants in `error_codes`; the SDK's own are for what goes wrong before Core answers. A newer Core may answer with a code this list doesn't have yet.

| Code | Text |
| --- | --- |
| `error_codes::API_KEYS_LIST_FAILED` | {{detail}} |
| `error_codes::API_KEY_IN_URL` | Send the API key in the Authorization header, not in the address. |
| `error_codes::API_KEY_REQUIRED` | Create an API key or add a person before allowing access from other devices. |
| `error_codes::APPROVE_FAILED` | {{detail}} |
| `error_codes::ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND` | That attempt is gone. |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_FAILED` | {{detail}} |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_INTERRUPTED` | The run didn't finish because Toskar stopped while it ran. It runs again at its next time. |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_INVALID` | {{detail}} |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_NOT_WEBHOOK` | This automation doesn't run from a webhook. |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_NO_RESULT` | This run has no result to continue in chat. |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_PAUSED` | This automation is paused. |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_RUNNING` | This automation is already running. Its result will appear here when it finishes. |
| `error_codes::AUTOMATION_TIMEOUT` | The run took longer than {{minutes}} minutes and was stopped. Try a faster model or a shorter prompt. |
| `error_codes::BAD_REQUEST` | {{detail}} |

| `CONNECTION_FAILED` (the SDK's own) | Couldn't reach Toskar at …: … |
| `DISCOVERY_FAILED` (the SDK's own) | Couldn't look for computers on the network: … |
| `HTTP_<status>` (the SDK's own) | Toskar answered <status> with a body that isn't Toskar's |
| `NOT_CONFIRMED` (the SDK's own) | The short pin wasn't confirmed |
| `NO_RECORD` (the SDK's own) | No address record for the computer: it may be off or asleep, or have no access from anywhere |
| `PIN_MISMATCH` (the SDK's own) | The computer's certificate isn't the one paired with |
| `RECORD_PIN` (the SDK's own) | The record isn't from the pinned computer |
| `RECORD_SEALED` (the SDK's own) | The record doesn't open with this route secret |
| `RECORD_STALE` (the SDK's own) | The record is too old |
| `UNREACHABLE` (the SDK's own) | The computer can't be reached |
